subject: Invoice cadence, PO referencing & net terms — HealthAxis procurement
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthaxis.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthaxis.com
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice cadence & PO referencing for Redwood contract

Hi Irene,

Thanks for moving quickly here. A couple procurement constraints on our side that will affect how we consume Redwood invoices:

- We need each invoice to reference an active PO number and corresponding cost-center code (our AP requires PO -> invoice mapping).
- Our default payment cycle is net60, but we can discuss net45 for strategic vendors; net30 is very unlikely for central procurement.
- For reporting, we prefer weekly invoice files (for each BU) rather than a single monthly invoice.
- We attach our PO template — please confirm the fields you need populated.

Can Redwood support weekly invoice cadence and mapping to multiple PO numbers per month? If there are operational surcharges for weekly batching, please call that out.

Also include any options around a booking discount or onboarding credit if we can consolidate future spend onto a single yearly commitment number.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director of Procurement
HealthAxis
(attachment: HealthAxis_PO_Template_v4.xlsx)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthaxis.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO referencing for Redwood contract

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear summary and the PO template. We can support the scenarios you described; options below so procurement can pick the best fit:

1) Standard (recommended): Net30, single consolidated invoice per month with line items mapped to your PO numbers and BU cost-centers. No processing fee.

2) Weekly invoices: We can emit weekly invoices split by BU and PO reference. To cover additional AP reconciliation overhead, we propose a small operational fee of 1.5% on weekly invoices (can be surfaced as a line item or absorbed via a slightly different rate).

3) Net45 accommodation: We can accept Net45 without an operational fee, but we would ask for quarterly reconciliation and a single remittance alias (to avoid lockbox fragmentation).

Discounts / onboarding credits: We can offer either a one-time onboarding credit or a volume-based discount tied to an annual committed spend. I attached a proposed invoice schedule (Redwood_Invoice_Schedule_Proposal.xlsx) that shows how fields from your PO template would map to our invoices, plus sample line formatting.

If you prefer Net45 and weekly invoices together, that combination increases our AP risk; we would need to trade on credit (short-term credit hold or a small onboarding credit).

Would you be able to share the internal approver name for net-term exceptions? Also please confirm whether each weekly invoice needs a separate PO number or whether the same PO can be referenced multiple times across weeks.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Strategic Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Schedule_Proposal.xlsx)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Feb 2027 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO referencing for Redwood contract

Irene — quick finance take so you have an offer to present:

- Operational fee for weekly invoices is plausible, but we should avoid gating the deal. If HealthAxis is strategic, propose we waive the weekly processing fee if they commit to an annual spend band (e.g., $600k+).
- Alternatively, offer a 5% one-time onboarding credit (applied to the first invoice) if they accept Net45 and consolidated PO referencing afterwards. That keeps cashflow predictable for them and limits our exposure.
- If they insist on Net60, push back: offer Net60 only if they provide a PO-backed prepayment or letter of credit for the first 90 days.

Recommended language for Irene to present: "We can support weekly or monthly invoice cadence; for weekly we typically apply a modest processing fee, but for HealthAxis we will waive the fee when you commit to an annual spend level OR accept Net45 with a 5% onboarding credit."

Irene — flag me if they push Net60; we need an explicit credit control step.

-Markus
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthaxis.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthaxis.com
Date: Thu, 04 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO referencing for Redwood contract

Irene / team,

Appreciate the options. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Our default is Net60; we will accept Net45 only for vendors with whom we have a negotiated SLA/price advantage. We cannot commit to Net30.
- We can accept weekly invoices referencing the same PO number multiple times across the month. That helps our cashflow visibility.
- We are amenable to a one-time onboarding credit but would prefer it to be expressed as a percentage off the first invoice (easier for AP). 5% is acceptable, but if that restores Redwood's revenue recognition we might ask for 6% instead.

I've attached an updated PO template and marked the PO-number and cost-center fields we rely on. We will need the final contract amendment (DocuSign) to reflect Net45 and the weekly invoice cadence.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Director of Procurement
HealthAxis
(attachment: HealthAxis_PO_Template_v4.xlsx)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthaxis.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 16:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO referencing for Redwood contract

Marta — thanks, that helps. Final proposal from Redwood: 

- Net45 term accepted.
- Weekly invoice cadence supported; our billing system will reference the PO number on each weekly invoice (same PO can be used multiple times). No operational surcharge.
- One-time onboarding credit: 5% off the first invoice. Alternatively, we can provide a fixed-dollar onboarding credit of $12,000; please confirm preference.

Next steps:
1) I am attaching a redline to the master SOW/Order Form to reflect Net45 and weekly invoice cadence (contract-redline.pdf).
2) I will prepare a DocuSign amendment and send to your procurement inbox (I can include the HubSpot deal id for tracking).
3) Once signed, our onboarding & billing teams will ingest your PO template fields and run a one-off reconciliation to ensure BU codes map correctly.

If HealthAxis confirms the 5% first-invoice credit, we will waive any weekly processing surcharge. If you prefer the $12k flat credit instead, that will be applied to the first invoice and recorded in the amendment.

Please confirm which credit option you want and who will sign the DocuSign.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Strategic Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(attachment: contract-redline.pdf)
